focus: Layer 2 — B2C global marketplaces with official, ToS-compliant affiliate APIs.
note: Official-API-only sourcing. No scraping/evasion, no fabricated data. B2B platforms (CJ Dropshipping, Zendrop, Alibaba/1688) were removed per the product pivot. Fields marked 'unverified' need confirmation against live credentials.

aliexpress.auth: HMAC-MD5 signed POST (ALIEXPRESS_APP_KEY + ALIEXPRESS_APP_SECRET) to https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync
aliexpress.notes: Production-ready; the one live provider today.

ebay.auth: OAuth2 client-credentials Application token from EBAY_APP_ID + EBAY_CERT_ID; scope https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope
ebay.affiliateLinks: itemAffiliateWebUrl when affiliate context header is sent (eBay Partner Network campaign id)
ebay.rateLimits: 5,000 Browse calls/day on the default application keyset
ebay.notes: Credential-gated; real client implemented. Untested against live API pending EBAY_APP_ID/EBAY_CERT_ID.

amazon.auth: AWS Signature V4 over AMAZON_ACCESS_KEY + AMAZON_SECRET_KEY; AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG as PartnerTag
amazon.affiliateLinks: DetailPageURL is the associate-tagged link; no separate link call needed
amazon.rateLimits: Tight TPS/TPD quotas tied to associate sales; 429 = TooManyRequests (adapter degrades to empty)
amazon.notes: SigV4 hand-implemented to spec but UNVERIFIED against the live endpoint (no keys here). Confirm with a real Associate account. CustomerReviews resources are commonly access-restricted, so trustScore uses a flat marketplace baseline (AMAZON_BASELINE_TRUST).

temu_aggregator.notes: Temu exposes no official public catalog API. The union literal is a forward-looking placeholder only; sourcing would require a LICENSED third-party aggregator feed (not scraping). No adapter exists.

removed.cjdropshipping: Removed per B2B pivot (was a CJ OpenAPI skeleton).
removed.zendrop: Removed per B2B pivot (had no public catalog API anyway).

recommendation: AliExpress is live. eBay (Browse API) is the most straightforward next activation — stable OAuth + generous quota. Amazon PAAPI 5 is implemented but needs a vetted Associate account (sales-gated quotas) and live SigV4 verification. temu_aggregator has no compliant source and stays disabled.
